Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the awards information, misassigning categories and mixing TV and film results, then prematurely marked the task complete. They stated Breaking Bad won Best Television Series – Musical or Comedy (it won Drama), Brooklyn Nine-Nine won Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy (it’s a TV series), and American Hustle won Best Motion Picture – Drama (it won Musical or Comedy), contradicting the evidence surfaced by WebSurfer.
